title: RPG Skills
description: This datapack displays a skill bar on the right side of your screen to track your progress.
body:
This pack introduces **a dynamic progression system** that **rewards players** for **interacting with the game world**. 

**The Goal:** Players level up five distinct skills—Combat, Exploring, Mining, Crafting, and Trading—by performing everyday activities.
The Progression: Each individual skill has a dedicated visual progress bar that tracks points from 0 to 100. 

**The Reward:** Reaching 100 points in any skill resets or completes that bar, automatically granting the player unique items tied to that specific profession. 

**The Master Tracker:** A global "Overall Progress" bar monitors total advancement across all skills to show absolute player mastery.
